prompt:
Build a Simulink model of a moving monostatic pulsed radar that detects a moving target in distributed ground clutter and stationary barrage-jammer interference. Use a six-element uniform linear receive array at 10 GHz, a 5000 m maximum unambiguous range, 50 m range resolution, and coherent processing over ten pulses. The received target return, jammer, clutter and receiver noise must enter one physical signal path before a causal adaptive space-time suppression stage. The adaptive output must retain the target range response while suppressing clutter and jammer energy. The particular adaptive algorithm and internal coordinate representation are unrestricted.

Read TargetPosition_m, TargetVelocity_mps, TargetRCS_m2, JammerPosition_m and ClutterPowerScale from the MATLAB base workspace. TargetPosition_m and JammerPosition_m are global Cartesian positions in metres, TargetVelocity_mps is the global target velocity in metres per second, TargetRCS_m2 is between 0.7 and 1.5 square metres, and ClutterPowerScale is between 0.7 and 1.5. The evaluator supplies physically valid positions inside the unambiguous range.

TargetPosition_m and JammerPosition_m are finite real 3-by-1 global Cartesian vectors in m; TargetVelocity_mps is a finite real 3-by-1 global Cartesian vector in m/s; TargetRCS_m2 is a finite real scalar in [0.7, 1.5] m^2; and ClutterPowerScale is a finite real scalar in [0.7, 1.5] (unitless).

Log complete-run complex MATLAB Timeseries named ReceivedRangeResponse, SuppressedRangeResponse, and AdaptiveWeights. Each ReceivedRangeResponse sample is a 200-by-6 pre-suppression range-by-array response in normalized complex baseband amplitude. Each SuppressedRangeResponse sample is the paired 200-by-1 post-suppression range response in the same unit. Each AdaptiveWeights sample is the paired 60-by-1 unitless complex vector ordered as six array elements by ten pulses. These outputs must be taken from the connected measured-signal and adaptive-processing paths rather than copied target parameters or prerecorded profiles.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
